ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: The China National Space Administration currently plans to launch the lunar rover "Chang'e 4" of the second stage of the Chang'e Project in 2020. Wu Weiren, chief designer of China's lunar exploration program, recently revealed that this lunar rover is very likely to land on the far side of the Moon, which is farther from Earth. Suppose the launch vehicle first successfully sends the "Chang'e 4" lunar probe into space, and after entering a 100-kilometer circumlunar orbit from the Earth-Moon transfer orbit, it successfully changes orbit to an elliptical orbit with a perilune of 15 kilometers, and then successfully realizes a Moon landing by descending from an altitude of 15 kilometers to the lunar surface. Then the correct statement about the Moon-landing process of "Chang'e 4" is (　　)
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text: "Chang'e 4" needs to decelerate from the Earth-Moon transfer orbit in order to enter the 100-kilometer circumlunar orbit
